statement: The complete preregistered public-surface MovieLens grouped-reduce matrix across dataset size, skew, and topology produces correctness-equivalent paired SLO capacity, whole-topology resource, infrastructure-cost, uncertainty, and practical-effect evidence for every cell regardless of direction.
